items.text:
The title's opening double quotes are wrong (99, not 66).
The opening settings don't let you choose full screen. It turns out it is an unlabelled icon.
The opening tutorial shows you how to control the hand and fingers. Then it turns out you can't do that in the game, and just press letters for thoughts.
It's one of those things that has you mildly annoyed before the "game" begins.
items.text_zh:
标题开头的双引号是错的（应该是99，不是66）。
开头的设置不让你选择全屏。结果发现那是个没有标签的图标。
开头的教程教你如何控制手和手指。然后结果发现你在游戏里做不到，只能按字母来思考。
这就是那种在“游戏”开始之前就让你有点恼火的东西。

observations.description: 设置菜单中全屏选项没有标签，只是一个图标
observations.evidence: The opening settings don't let you choose full screen. It turns out it is an unlabelled icon.
observations.evidence_zh: 开头的设置不让你选择全屏。结果那是一个没有标签的图标。

items.text:
I can completely relate to this game, pretty much what I think on any date I've been on, its a full on story driven experience, the dialogue is good and the music too
There's a few issues with it
- the sound options are ok, the music sometimes drowns out what your character is saying, but that could be because i have really bad hearing, it works better for me through headphones
-some of the icons which are used for selecting things, i.e pouring wine or eating bread are a little confusing, I think it would have been better to just have words rather than pictures for selecting or maybe they should be bigger icons.
god i sound like i'm 300 years old or something

other than that its fairly funny to listen to this guy saying he wants to shag his date even though she hasn't turned up, I got this in a sale, and that's what I recommend, get it when its on offer, I paid out 40 pence or something for it.
items.text_zh:
我完全能对这款游戏产生共鸣，基本上就是我在任何一次约会中会有的想法，它是一场完整的剧情驱动体验，对话不错，音乐也是
它有几个问题
- 声音选项还行，音乐有时会盖过你的角色在说什么，但那可能是因为我听力真的很差，用耳机对我来说效果更好
- 有些用来选择东西的图标，比如倒酒或吃面包，有点让人困惑，我觉得用文字而不是图片来选择会更好，或者也许它们应该做成更大的图标。
god，我听起来像300岁似的

除此之外，听这家伙说他想上他的约会对象，尽管她根本没出现，还挺好笑的，我是打折时买的，这就是我的推荐，等它打折时再买，我大概花了40便士还是多少买的。

observations.description: 用于选择动作的图标令人困惑
observations.evidence: some of the icons which are used for selecting things, i.e pouring wine or eating bread are a little confusing
observations.evidence_zh: 有些用来选择东西的图标，比如倒酒或吃面包，有点让人摸不着头脑

items.text:
I very rarely experience a game so boring that it puts me to sleep. Unfortunately this is one of them. I was actively trying to put this guy out of his misery. 

This could easily have been called "Eating bread and soup Simulator". That's basically all you do in this game. You hear this dude rant angrily because he's been stood up by his date, you eat bread and soup, he rants some more and that's pretty much it. This game would have been fine as a visual novel or as a short movie. I could barely make out what the icons meant and many of them doesn't lead anywhere. The most advanced thing you do in this game is stirr the soup. Wow.
items.text_zh:
我很少遇到一个无聊到让我睡着的游戏。不幸的是，这就是其中之一。我积极地试图让这家伙摆脱痛苦。

这完全可以被称为“吃面包和汤模拟器”。这基本上就是你在游戏里做的全部事情。你听到这家伙愤怒地咆哮，因为他被约会对象放了鸽子，你吃面包和汤，他又咆哮更多，差不多就这些了。这个游戏作为视觉小说或短片本来会不错。我几乎看不懂图标是什么意思，而且很多图标不会导向任何地方。你在这个游戏里做的最先进的事情就是搅拌汤。哇。

observations.description: 图标难以理解，且许多图标没有实际作用
observations.evidence: I could barely make out what the icons meant and many of them doesn't lead anywhere.
observations.evidence_zh: 我几乎分辨不出那些图标是什么意思，而且其中许多都没有导向任何地方。

items.text: Interesting idea for storytelling, but not quite enough was done with it.  The controls are a bit awkward, because it can be quite difficult to make out the letters and what actions they're associated with...but it ends up not really mattering when it doesn't feel like you have much agency anyway.  With a little bit better writing, a cleaner interface, and and more of a sense that the player is directing the experience, it could be the equivalent of an interactive short film, but in the state it's in I'm not convinced it's worth money.
items.text_zh: 讲故事的构思很有趣，但并没有充分利用它。操作有点别扭，因为很难辨认字母以及它们关联的动作……但反正最后也不太重要，因为感觉你本来也没什么自主权。如果写作稍微好一点、界面更清晰，并且更能让玩家感觉自己是在主导这段体验，它本可以相当于一部互动短片，但以它现在的状态，我不相信它值这个钱。
